entities.name: Cilissa
entities.description: A girl orphaned in an Akroan attack who is taken in by Setessa, grows into a fast, gifted warrior, and in the end becomes the one who welcomes new arkulli.

entities.name: Thora
entities.description: Cilissa's aggressive, taller sparring partner and friend among the Setessan children; she grows into a veteran warrior and is turned to stone by a gorgon.

entities.name: Niketa
entities.description: A Setessan weaponsmaster, archer and head trainer who teaches Cilissa that warriors fight with their minds.

entities.name: Kelios
entities.description: An awkward Setessan boy who leaves on his peregrination and says goodbye to Thora and Cilissa.

entities.name: Natasa
entities.description: A calm, prepared Setessan warrior who fights beside Cilissa and Thora and is turned to stone.

entities.name: Delia
entities.description: A sixteen-year-old Setessan warrior facing her first battle, killed by a minotaur.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: The god of Setessa who welcomes the arkulli, appears as a face in the stars of Nyx, and whose pods grow after the welcoming ceremony.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: A god who blighted the Despair Lands into a wasteland.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: A society of warrior women in the Nessian Wood that shelters orphaned children, trains them as warriors, and sends its boys away on peregrinations.

entities.name: Nessian Wood
entities.description: The forest home of Setessa, with ancient olive trees and a portal to Nyx in its clearing.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The starry realm of the gods, glimpsed through a portal above the welcoming clearing.

entities.name: Despair Lands
entities.description: A wasteland blighted by Erebos, two days of travel south of the Nessian Wood.

entities.name: Akroans
entities.description: The attackers who raided Cilissa's village and killed her father.

entities.name: Nyxborn
entities.description: Beings with bodies made of the night sky, shaped as humans, centaurs, minotaurs and others, who invade Setessa after the gods vanish.

entities.name: Arkulli
entities.description: The name Setessa gives to the orphaned children it takes in.

entities.name: Karametra's pods
entities.description: Glowing green husks that sprout after the welcoming ceremony and grow over the years; one splits open and dissolves the Nyxborn.

entities.name: Peregrination
entities.description: The journey into the outside world that every Setessan boy takes at fourteen.

entities.name: The Silence
entities.description: The period when the gods went absent, a few months before the Nyxborn invasion.

events.summary: Orphaned children stream into a forest clearing in Setessa, among them Cilissa, who forces herself not to cry.
events.quote: So many children.

events.summary: Cilissa enters the clearing and sees the portal to Nyx open in the sky above.
events.quote: Nyx. The home of the gods.

events.summary: A tall woman tells the children they are safe, and that their parents are gone and not coming back.
events.quote: "Welcome, Little Ones. You are safe here."

events.summary: The woman names the children arkulli, little bears, and declares them Setessan; the stars form a bear.
events.quote: "Welcome, arkulli . From now on, you are Setessan.

events.summary: The stars form the face of Karametra, who whispers to Cilissa that she is loved.
events.quote: the face of the god Karametra

events.summary: Karametra's sparks grow into glowing pods; holding one, Cilissa remembers the Akroan attack, her father's fall, and her flight from her mother's last order.
events.quote: Her father falling to the first wave of Akroan attackers.

events.summary: Cilissa cries while hugging the pod, and smiles for the first time since the attack, grateful to be home.
events.quote: But for the first time since the attack, she smiled.

events.summary: Years later, Thora beats Cilissa in staff sparring while taunting her; Cilissa holds back and does not counter.
events.quote: "Hah, I win."

events.summary: Niketa confronts Cilissa and spars with her, repeatedly asking what she fights with.
events.quote: "What do you fight with, Child?"

events.summary: Cilissa lashes out in anger, and Niketa teaches her that warriors fight with their minds and must recognize goading.
events.quote: You fight with your mind.

events.summary: On a snowy patrol at the southern edge of the forest, Cilissa and Thora are surprised by Kelios.
events.quote: "Kelios," they said in unison

events.summary: Kelios says goodbye before leaving on his peregrination, and looks only at Cilissa while Thora hugs him.
events.quote: "I'm going to miss you, Cilissa."

events.summary: Thora, in tears, accuses Cilissa of being perfect and passive and walks away, leaving her patrol partner.
events.quote: "No, of course not. Perfect Cilissa. Perfect, passive Cilissa.

events.summary: Cilissa finds a large pod free of snow and rests against it, thinking of her parents and of lives she might lead.
events.quote: and then realized it was one of Karametra's pods.

events.summary: Cilissa, now eighteen, waits with Thora, Natasa and Delia as Nyxborn invade Setessa from the north and west after the Silence.
events.quote: thousands of Nyxborn had invaded Setessa from the north and the west.

events.summary: The Nyxborn charge; Cilissa kills a centaur and a swordsman with her spear.
events.quote: A centaur charged into Cilissa's spear

events.summary: A minotaur cuts Delia in half; Cilissa cripples and kills the minotaur with her axe.
events.quote: Delia had no time to scream as the minotaur's huge axe cut her midsection in two.

events.summary: A gorgon turns Thora to stone, and Cilissa flees.
events.quote: saw Thora's body turn a pale shade of chalk-gray.

events.summary: Cilissa kills the gorgon by springing off a large pod and hurling her axe, then sees Natasa and Thora turned to statues and her friends slain.
events.quote: She saw the sprawled corpse of the gorgon, the axe embedded in its face.

events.summary: Wounded and despairing, Cilissa fights on with her knives, hearing Niketa's lessons and Karametra's whisper.
events.quote: But what good was her mind when her friends were dead and her god was gone?

events.summary: Cilissa, screaming for an answer, tries to break the pod with her knife and fails, then dodges a minotaur's charge.
events.quote: "What do you want from me?" she screamed into the forest.

events.summary: The minotaur's axe splits the pod open when Cilissa dodges.
events.quote: the minotaur's axe hit the pod squarely in the center, splitting it open from top to bottom.

events.summary: Green light and sounds fill the forest and every Nyxborn dissolves into nothingness.
events.quote: The Nyxborn slowly dissolved into nothingness.

events.summary: Cilissa realizes the pod saved her and crawls to tell someone of the other pods, then passes out from blood loss.
events.quote: Still, the pod had saved her.

events.summary: Years later, Cilissa, limping, walks to the center of the welcoming clearing and speaks to a new group of orphans in the same words as the first woman.
events.quote: "Welcome, Little Ones. You are safe here. You are home."
